metrics.label: 28-tufts-tpol-crosstab
metrics.diagnostics: Tufts Public Opinion Lab pre-election poll (YouGov, Oct 23-27, weighted LV N 499; Box PDF linked by the user): House vote by race White 46/46, Black 93/5, Hispanic 63/23, topline 52/40. No 2024 pair, so it moves only the level. Poll averages: white R+5.2 -> R+4.9, Black D+74.6 -> D+75.3, Hispanic D+30.0 -> D+30.9; S +10.84 -> +11.22; national D+9.34 -> D+9.72. House 234 -> 235 D-leaning, median 238 -> 239, P(D majority) 0.972 -> 0.979. Senate P(D control) 0.692 -> 0.705, no race changes side. Governors P(D majority) 0.701 -> 0.707.
